title: Peer Consensus Layer
tagline: PCL is a fully decentralized p2p consensus layer. Developed for XMBL but chain agnostic.
how_its_made: For the example implementation, we'll be using javascript in the browser and Rust on the backend. We will demonstrate the use via a simulator on the backend and show how the chrome extension interacts with growing conditions under mempool stress with real-time conditions. This is the consensus layer for the upcoming XMBL testnet estimated in November.
